## ⌨️ Manual checks
- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation.
- [ ] Visible focus indicators.
- [ ] Logical heading and landmark structure.
- [ ] Image alternatives.
- [ ] Accessible names for controls.
- [ ] Contrast measured.
- [ ] 200% zoom and reflow.
- [ ] Screen-reader reading order.
- [ ] Reduced motion, if animation exists.

## 🤖 Automated checks
Record tool/version, date, URL, and exact findings.

## ⚖️ Limitations
State browsers, assistive technologies, or content not covered.

## 📝 Outcome
Do not claim WCAG conformance unless the evaluation scope and evidence support that statement.
